# Allync - AI & Digital Business Solutions

> Allync (AllyncAI) provides AI-powered business automation and digital transformation solutions for companies in Turkey, Qatar, and globally.

## Company Overview
Allync is a technology company specializing in AI-powered customer service automation and digital solutions. We help businesses automate their customer interactions, build their online presence, and grow in the digital world.

**Headquarters:** Istanbul, Turkey
**Operations:** Turkey, Qatar, Middle East, Global
**Languages:** Turkish, English, Arabic
**Website:** https://www.allyncai.com

## AI Solutions

### WhatsApp AI Assistants
Intelligent chatbots for 24/7 automated customer service via WhatsApp.
- Instant response to customer inquiries
- Appointment booking and scheduling
- Order tracking and updates
- Sales process automation
- Multi-language support (Turkish, English, Arabic)

### Custom AI Chatbots
Tailored conversational AI solutions for specific business needs.
- Custom-trained models for your industry
- CRM integration
- Automated lead generation
- Customer segmentation

### Voice AI & Cloning
Advanced voice synthesis and cloning technology.
- Brand voice digitization
- Automated voice response systems
- Call center automation
- IVR systems

### Document AI
Intelligent document processing and analysis.
- Automatic data extraction from PDF, Word, Excel
- Invoice processing
- Contract analysis
- Document classification

### Data Analysis AI
AI-powered business intelligence and analytics.
- Sales forecasting
- Customer behavior analysis
- Trend detection
- Automated reporting

## Digital Solutions

### Web Development
Modern, fast, SEO-optimized websites.
- React, Next.js, modern technologies
- Responsive design
- E-commerce integration
- Payment systems
- Admin panels

### Mobile App Development
iOS and Android native and cross-platform applications.
- React Native, Flutter
- App Store & Google Play publishing
- Push notifications
- Offline support

### E-commerce Solutions
Online sales platforms and store setup.
- Payment integrations (iyzico, PayTR, Stripe)
- Inventory management
- Shipping integration
- Automated invoicing

### Digital Marketing
SEO, Google Ads, and social media advertising.
- Content marketing
- Email marketing
- Conversion optimization
- Analytics and reporting

### Cloud Solutions
AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure infrastructure services.
- Server setup
- Backup and security
- Cloud migration
- Performance optimization

### Custom SaaS Development
We build custom SaaS (Software as a Service) products for businesses.
- Cloud-based, scalable platforms
- Multi-tenant architecture
- Subscription billing integration
- API-first design
- White-label solutions
- Full product development lifecycle

### IoT Solutions
Internet of Things integration and smart device management.
- Sensor data collection
- Industrial IoT
- Smart building solutions
- Automation systems

## Industry Solutions

- **Restaurants & Cafes:** Online ordering, reservation systems, WhatsApp menus
- **E-commerce:** Automated support, order tracking, returns management
- **Healthcare:** Appointment systems, patient tracking, reminders
- **Real Estate:** Auto-response to listings, scheduling, customer matching
- **Education:** Student support, enrollment automation, notifications
- **Tourism:** Reservation management, tour information, 24/7 support

## Why Choose Allync?

- Local support in Turkey and Qatar
- Turkish, English, and Arabic language support
- Custom solutions - not off-the-shelf packages
- 24/7 technical support
- Fast setup and integration
- Scalable infrastructure
